cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking about her vase. I've decided you'll keep your promise to your little brother.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I at least clear the cleaner? She's getting blamed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That correction is approved. You may establish her innocence without naming me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum asked directly whether you broke it. What do I say?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may tell her yes. Then come back and explain why I should tell you anything again. I'll decide whether your next promise is worth accepting.
